text: Pressure skid on pipeline segment 7, inspection stills attached. job: find each flange, valve and gauge in the frames and box them with coordinates | where: nothing leaves the compressor station, process it here | accuracy: baseline level is fine, no need for anything fancy.

Clause 4.2, Fleet Cabin Imaging. Service: identification of every passenger, bag and aisle obstruction in the onboard bus imagery, with a box returned for each item. Accuracy tier: the provider shall apply its most precise model grade. Handling: requests under this clause go ahead of the ordinary queue and are executed as a priority.
[Cleanroom Suite 3 / particle counter] Display snapshot received. action: transcribe the printed count and batch label | accuracy: the default tier will do.
Okay Nova, new job. Task, box every passenger and stroller on the ferry gangway ramp. Accuracy, best available. Timing, usual queue, nothing pressing.

Reefer van 22, rear cargo door. request: read the temperature logger printout and the pallet labels | precision: needs to be exact, run the strongest model, since misread digits would fail the audit.

yo, the screen door panel at Central platform keeps flashing an error string. ask: read what's on the display from these snaps | cloud: totally fine to send it off-site | accuracy: gotta be dead-on, don't cheap out

Service Term 9, Checkpoint X-ray Imaging. Deliverable: each suspicious item within scanned luggage shall be identified and enclosed by a bounding rectangle. Accuracy: the baseline service tier is deemed adequate for this deliverable.
AGV-07 / dock scan complete. next step: read the shipping label text on the tote in view | timing: routine, no hurry.

Hi Luca, following up on the pole-mounted cameras along King St. request: mark every parked scooter and bin on the footpath and give me box coordinates | accuracy: nothing special, the default model is enough | timing: whenever it comes up in the ordinary queue, we're not in a hurry. Thanks, Ana
OR 4 air monitor. task: transcribe the particulate and humidity figures off the panel photo | handling: stays inside the hospital network, no external upload | accuracy: everyday level will do.
hey! flare stack pics from the rig -> task: read the nameplate + gauge tag text | send to cloud: sure, go ahead | when: no rush, regular turnaround

SiteGate helmet scanner > morning entry frames ready. output: headcount of workers wearing hard hats, number only | data: remains on the site server | accuracy: maximum, this feeds the safety log.
Hey Echo, bed twelve's monitor. Readout, the numbers and alarm text on this screen photo. Precision, top level, no guessing on digits.

Hi Dev, dashcam stills from haul truck HT-31 came through overnight. ask: how many loaded trucks are queued at the crusher in each frame, one figure per image and nothing more | timing: routine, slot it in with the regular jobs, no rush. Regards, Kim
Drone flight over paddock 6. request: read the numbers on the irrigation valve tags in the aerial shots | processing: cloud is fine | accuracy: ordinary level is acceptable.
hiya, pressure line walkdown pics are up. q: how many corrosion spots along the exposed pipe? a bare figure | you can crunch it on the cloud, np

Article 6, Spreader Alignment Imaging. Service: the operator shall locate each twistlock and corner casting in the spreader imagery and return enclosing box coordinates for each. Scheduling: all such requests take precedence over routine work and shall be processed immediately upon receipt.
Tower Ridge-4 thermal > scan sweep logged. count: hotspots across the valley frame, integer only | location: process on the tower unit, don't transmit | pace: routine, nothing time-critical.
Hey Scout, watchtower job. Task, read the grid code painted on the marker board in the frame. Processing, cloud is okay. Priority, right away please.

Hi ops, the lobby parcel locker is jammed again. need: number of parcels visible in the open bays from the kiosk photo, a single figure | data: keep it on the kiosk itself, nothing to the cloud | timing: ASAP, the courier is waiting. Thanks, Jordan
M4 gantry, eastbound lanes. job: tally vehicles under the gantry in these frames, just the figure | data: remain on the roadside cabinet | queue: regular, not pressing.
hey, pump stn 3 inlet screen looks clogged | ask: box each chunk of debris on the grate in these shots | when: asap pls, crew's waiting on it

Provision 11: Compactor Fill Imaging. Output: a single integer stating how many bags are visible in the hopper image. Data handling: imagery shall be processed within the bin's own controller and not transmitted elsewhere. Priority: such requests shall be expedited ahead of routine traffic.
LiftGate Chair 3 > pass photo captured. action: read the pass ID printed on the card.
Hey Atlas, runway two-seven debris cam. Find each piece of debris on the tarmac and box it. Accuracy, regular is fine. Timing, whenever it's next in line, no rush.

Cell 12 welding robot. need: how many bolts remain in the feeder tray, number only | prio: expedite, the line is stopped.
morning! track scanner pass is uploaded -> task: box each cracked sleeper + loose clip | model: plain default is fine

Accuracy: an ordinary level of precision is acceptable. Scheduling: requests follow the regular processing order and carry no expedite status.
BridgeWatch > cable deck imagery ready. result: corroded anchor bolts, one number, no extras | processing location: on the pylon edge box, nothing off-site.
Hey Bessie, milking stall five. Cows in the holding pen, just the number. Accuracy, top notch please. Timing, no rush, it can wait its turn.

Hi Rosa, the climate controller in bay 2 snapped the tomato rows this morning. request: total ripe trusses in view, a figure only | location: process on the greenhouse's own box, no uploading | precision: regular level suits us. Thanks, Ben
Inverter pad 9, east array. job: locate each soiled or cracked panel in the drone stills and return a box per panel.
hey, pic of the aux generator nameplate from the engine room here. task: read off the serial + rating text | fine to push it to shore servers | accuracy: meh, regular's fine

Hey Marlin, fish pen three. Box every fish near the net wall in this underwater clip. Processing, the cloud's fine.

Carousel 5, international arrivals. task: read the printed tag numbers on the bags in these frames | data: stays inside the airport network.
